description: Eight-channel mixer with panning, mutes and a master fader; faders calibrated in decibels

params.text: That channel's level, -60dB to +6dB with unity at the 0 mark; the handle lights with the level leaving the channel
Silences that channel; right-click to solo it instead, muting every other channel until the next click
Pans that channel between the two outputs
The level of the whole mix, -60dB to +6dB with unity at the 0 mark
A partial cut of the whole mix, -12dB by default and settable on the menu

inputs.text: A 0-10V CV over that channel's level, attenuated by the fader; it acts in decibels unless linear level CV response is turned on in the menu
A bipolar CV, -5 to +5V, over that channel's panning, attenuverted by the pan knob
That channel's signal into the mixer; a polyphonic cable here is summed to one signal
A 0-10V CV over the level of the mix, attenuated by the master fader

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, soft clipped at 12V; patched on its own it carries the whole mix in mono
The right side of the mix, soft clipped at 12V; patched on its own it carries the whole mix in mono

menu: Linear level CV response — the level CV inputs act linearly in amplitude, so 5V halves the level the fader sets, instead of acting in decibels
Dim amount — how far the DIM button cuts the master: -6dB, -12dB, -18dB or -24dB
Input 1 poly spread — spreads a polyphonic cable at input 1 across the eight channels: None, Channels 1-8 or Channels 9-16; a cable at another channel overrides it
